description: This file defines a class PDFProcessor that processes PDF files to extract text and images, including chunking text into manageable pieces and saving images to disk.

classes.name: PDFProcessor
classes.description: A class for processing PDF files to extract text and images, and chunking text into segments.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PDFProcessor, setting up the images directory.

methods.name: process_pdf
methods.description: Processes a PDF file to extract text chunks and images, returning them as lists of dictionaries.

methods.name: _chunk_text
methods.description: Splits text into overlapping chunks based on size settings.
